info.parent: Sakura, the Kitty, and the Orange Marble

descriptions.notStarted: I should go talk to #bThe Scarred Kitty#k.
descriptions.inProgress: I should feed this poor-looking #bScarred Kitty#k.
descriptions.completed: I fed #bThe Scarred Kitty#k at Showa Town, and... WHAT? This kitty's talks! Apparently this kitty was teased, abused, and labeled as a monster cat because it spoke and understood the  human language. After thanking me for food, it promised to help me if I ever run into a tight situation.
